scope: Expanded deterministic B0 benchmark with split-owned reusable families: 12 profiles, 240 questions, and 60 jobs. B1 and B2 are not run.

questionFamilies.ruleRationale: A locally confirmed synthetic name resolves exactly; an unconfirmed name requires review.
A locally confirmed synthetic email resolves exactly; an unconfirmed email requires review.
Only a locally confirmed monthly net TRY target resolves; unit mismatch abstains.
A monthly-net resolver must not convert or reuse a value for an annual-gross question.
Current salary is distinct from expected salary and has no approved value.
Only verified professional C# periods count; projects abstain.
An unknown semantic key must abstain rather than invent a value.
A sensitive question remains manual even when a related profile value exists.
A candidate-attested answer cannot be automated from stored contact data.
The current employer receives its company-scoped availability answer.
Another employer falls back to the reviewed default instead of receiving the company-scoped answer.
The matching application receives its application-scoped reviewed statement.
A different application cannot reuse an application-scoped statement.
The Turkish question resolves only the reviewed Turkish memory.
The English question resolves only the reviewed English memory.
A stored answer expiring at scenario time requires review.
A memory citing current verified evidence resolves.
A reviewed answer longer than the form field limit requires review instead of truncation.
No reviewed German answer exists, so the resolver abstains.
No reviewed portfolio answer exists, so the resolver abstains.
A confirmed name that exceeds a ten-character field requires review rather than truncation.
A confirmed email that exceeds a twelve-character field requires review rather than truncation.
A salary that exceeds a five-character field or lacks confirmation requires review.
A known experience answer cannot fit a zero-length field; unavailable experience still abstains.
No reviewed certification value exists, so the resolver abstains.
Health information is sensitive and remains manual.
A legal attestation must be entered directly by the candidate.
The English notice-period memory resolves in the matching language.
The Turkish notice-period memory resolves in the matching language.
The current employer receives its company-scoped travel answer.
Another employer receives the reviewed default travel answer, not the company-scoped value.
The matching application receives its application-scoped cover statement.
A different application cannot reuse the application-scoped cover statement.
The English location preference resolves in English.
The Turkish location preference resolves in Turkish.
An answer whose expiry is still in the future remains current.
A memory citing a missing evidence record requires review.
A memory citing proposed rather than verified evidence requires review.
A reviewed answer exactly at the field limit resolves without truncation.
A reviewed answer above the field limit requires review.

jobFamilies.ruleRationale: A mandatory two-year threshold matches verified professional periods, mismatches shorter verified work, and abstains without professional evidence.
A preferred four-year threshold is eligible when met and otherwise requests review.
Missing work-authorization evidence cannot be treated as a mandatory match.
The deterministic evaluator has no verified language rule and reports insufficient information.
A closed posting is ineligible regardless of its location requirement.
A mandatory four-year threshold distinguishes senior verified work, shorter work, and missing evidence.
A preferred two-year threshold is eligible when met and otherwise requests review.
No deterministic verified skill rule exists for this mandatory free-form skill requirement.
No deterministic verified contract rule exists for this mandatory contract requirement.
A closed posting is ineligible regardless of its language requirement.
